subcategory_text: Analysis is performed to establish what has taken place during an incident and the root cause of the incident
implementation_examples: Determine the sequence of events that occurred during the incident and which assets and resources were involved in each event
Attempt to determine what vulnerabilities, threats, and threat actors were directly or indirectly involved in the incident
Analyze the incident to find the underlying, systemic root causes
Check any cyber deception technology for additional information on attacker behavior
assessment_objectives: Determine whether analysis is performed to establish what has taken place during an incident and the root cause of the incident.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that determine the sequence of events that occurred during the incident and which assets and resources were involved in each event.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that attempt to determine what vulnerabilities, threats, and threat actors were directly or indirectly involved in the incident.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
